LESSON: SELECTED SURAHS

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Qur’an 1.1 Selected Surahs 2 Al-Fatiha 3 An-Naas 4 Al-Falaq 5 Al-Ikhlas 6 Al-Mas
Topic 1.1: Selected Surahs

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Selected Surahs. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why do we recite suratul - Fatiha in every swalah?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. read the selected surah for spiritual nourishment
2. recite the selected surah for use in devotional activities
3. explain the basic meaning of the selected surah to enhance positive character formation
4. apply the teachings of the selected surah in his/her daily life
5. appreciate the importance of the selected surahs by adhering to their teachings

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: SELECTED SURAHS
This lesson teaches Selected Surahs for Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

STUDY STEPS
1. read the selected surah for spiritual nourishment
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. recite the selected surah for use in devotional activities
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. explain the basic meaning of the selected surah to enhance positive character formation
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
4. apply the teachings of the selected surah in his/her daily life
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
5. appreciate the importance of the selected surahs by adhering to their teachings
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Selected Surahs using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Selected Surahs above.
2. Explain Selected Surahs to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Selected Surahs.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Selected Surahs with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Selected Surahs important for a Grade 4 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why do we recite suratul - Fatiha in every swalah?
2. Which surahs do Muslims recite before going to bed?
3. What lessons do we learn from the selected surahs?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. read the selected surah for spiritual nourishment
2. recite the selected surah for use in devotional activities
3. explain the basic meaning of the selected surah to enhance positive character formation
4. apply the teachings of the selected surah in his/her daily life

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
